questions.q: Statements: All pens are books. All books are bags. Conclusions: I. Some pens are not bags. II. Some pens are bags.
questions.why: Checked against every possible diagram of the statements: I need not be true, II must be true. GPSC-style practice item.

questions.q: A petroleum product's price rises 25% every odd year and falls 20% every even year. After exactly 8 years the price has
questions.why: × 1.25 × 0.8 = × 1 every two years, so after 8 years it is unchanged. GPSC CBRT, Jun 2025.

questions.q: A clock shows 4:30. It is placed so that the minute hand points east. In which direction does the hour hand point?
questions.why: At 4:30 the minute hand is at 6. If 6 points east, then 3 points north, and the hour hand, between 4 and 5, points north-east.

questions.q: Three cyclists X, Y and Z start together from the same point on a 480 m circular track. X and Y go clockwise at 4 and 6 m/s; Z goes anticlockwise at 8 m/s. When will all three first meet again at the starting point?
questions.why: Lap times 120, 80 and 60 s; LCM = 240 s. GPSC JSO pre-screening, Jun 2026.

questions.q: If TABLET is written as UCEPJZ in a certain code, how is NURSING written in that code?
questions.why: In the code the 1st letter moves 1 place, the 2nd 2 places, the 3rd 3 places, and so on: NURSING → OWUWNTN. GPSC-style practice item.

questions.q: A, B and C can do a work in 20, 30 and 60 days. In how many days can A do it if B and C help him every third day?
questions.why: Per 3 days: 3/20 + 1/30 + 1/60 = 12/60 = 1/5 of the work, so 15 days. GPSC CBRT, Mar 2025.

questions.q: Geeta walks 2 m West, then turns right and walks 2 m, then turns right and walks 3 m, then turns right and walks 2 m. Which direction is Geeta facing now?
questions.why: Follow each turn from the first direction: the last leg is towards the South. GPSC-style practice item.

questions.q: In a row of boys, Seby is 20th from the left and Alan 22nd from the right. When they swap, 18 boys are to the right of Alan. How many boys are in the row?
questions.why: After the swap Alan is 20th from the left with 18 to his right: 20 + 18 = 38. GPSC CBRT, Jun 2025.

questions.q: If 'P × Q' means P is the mother of Q, 'P + Q' means Q is the sister of P, and 'P − Q' means P is the daughter of Q, how is 'A is the aunt of B' denoted?
questions.why: B − C: B is C's daughter; C + A: A is C's sister. So A is B's aunt. GPSC CBRT, Dec 2024.
